card.name: Inside the word hypersensitivity
card.fires_on: Pieces of the word hypersensitivity (Hyp-ers-ensitivity), mostly the 'ers' or 'hypers' part, in warnings about skin rash and hypersensitivity reactions. It also fires weakly on 'benefits' or 'be' in benefit-risk phrasing.

modes.label: Hypersensitivity split
modes.description: The middle pieces of the word hypersensitivity in headings and warnings about rash or drug reactions.
modes.example: 5.1 Skin Rash and Hyp<<ers>>ensitivity Serious and sometimes fatal dermatologic reactions

modes.label: Benefit-risk wording
modes.description: Words such as 'be' or 'benefits' in sentences weighing benefits against risks.
modes.example: The benefits of mefloquine therapy should<< be>> weighed against the possibility of adverse effects in
